comatose

  • CURIE: gmeow:modeComatose
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/modeComatose
  • Category: individual
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/awareness
  • Box roles: ABox role (What is this?)

Coma — a state of profound unarousable unresponsiveness with no purposeful response to stimuli. The deepest pathological low-arousal mode, carrying gmeow:levelUnresponsive; mapping to clinical consciousness scales (Glasgow Coma Scale, by reference).

Structure

Types: gmeow:AwarenessMode

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:modeComatose as a controlled value typed as gmeow:AwarenessMode.
